purpose: Non-admission discovery and deduplicated research of additional compound-event, tropical-cyclone, storm-surge and flood-screening products from Exa and original provider evidence, checked against current main and open 2026-11-02 CAT source PRs; all rights and scientific admission remain blocked pending explicit review.

entries.name: European Multi-Hazard Dataset in Sparse Array Format v1
entries.provider: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam / University of Oxford (Claassen, Koks)
entries.spatial_scope: Europe, varying by hazard source and observation window
entries.resolution_or_granularity: NetCDF sparse spatial/temporal event arrays and CSV event/pair indexes; about 6.1 GB published, pairs flood-windstorm and heatwave-wildfire
entries.note: New dataset package is a transformation of separately known ERA5-Land, EFFIS, C3S windstorm tracks/footprints and JRC flood depth; not an independent observational source for those hazards. Each event has own id/time and sparse coordinate representation; flood intensity is centimetres, event-info intensity labelled Mean wind speed (m/s), NOT peak gust, wildfire burned-area binary. Preserve event IDs, sparse grid/CRS, original input provenance, overlap algorithm and original source rights. Dataset page lists file hashes as MD5; compute SHA-256 for a bounded rights-cleared artifact. License and use scope require direct provider confirmation. Do not interpret overlap pairs as simultaneous insured losses. Verified read-only original hazardinfows.csv 32,210 bytes, 234 distinct wind-event IDs; computed SHA-256 35f10da966ad8b6f0bc5fd9dba904bb8251ae11a9f52fe7e10f4f6ff9e2bf787 and publisher MD5 e58a511d83da230931b57cb9822d8841 matched. Full sparse data archive not fetched; model/rights review remains blocked.

entries.name: Global 12000-year synthetic tropical cyclone track ensembles by ENSO regime
entries.temporal_scope: Climatology 1980-2021; release 2025-03-27 v2; 12000 simulated years per climate regime/basin
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ZIP archives by historical baseline, neutral ENSO, El Niño, and La Niña; stochastic track records and city return-period summary
entries.note: IH-STORM model code: https://github.com/IHCantabria/IH-STORM and https://zenodo.org/records/23763850 (2026-10-29); original STORM lineage: https://github.com/NBloemendaal/STORM. Synthetic model output, not historical observations or wind-field footprints. Preserve basin, stochastic year, track id, ENSO regime, baseline and exact release; review license of dataset and model separately. Check dependencies with IBTrACS and any previously registered STORM-derived sources to avoid treating the ensemble as independent truth. Original README.txt 3,800 bytes read-only and SHA-256-verified: 80c913ae6d46f58a8ab9c6dc435e552e5743f3a3edca618c59841acaea00280e; specifies 3-hour timestep, maximum 10-min sustained wind in m/s, longitudes 0-360 and 1,000-year shard semantics. No ZIP tracks read.

entries.name: Global cyclone-attributed storm-surge hydrographs GTSMv3/GESLAv3
entries.provider: IHCantabria TRANSCLIMA / Deltares / Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
entries.spatial_scope: Global coastal stations/basins represented by station and storm IDs
entries.temporal_scope: Historical tropical cyclones and GTSMv3 1980-2022 reanalysis; source-specific GESLAv3 observations
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Storm- and basin-partitioned NetCDF event/full time series and CSV per-station hydrographs; published about 456 MB files
entries.note: Derived via DKM-DBSCAN Hazard Tracker (https://github.com/IHCantabria/TRANSCLIMA.hazard_tracker; https://zenodo.org/records/23765126) and GTSMv3/GESLAv3. Companion method describes 2723 historical cyclones. GTSM modelled and GESLA gauge paths are not independent if collated into one target; preserve original station/SID, time units, vertical reference, gauge quality, and storm-event identity. Hydrograph is water level surge, not inundation depth or damage. Rights on all contributing data and derived outputs require review. Original README.txt 7,005 bytes read-only and SHA-256-verified: c06107caa6aea8de4116b8fbc264547dd2b6696ac1030ae75b4de0d78d867abd; confirms storm SIDs from IBTrACS and surge in metres. No ZIP hydrographs read.

entries.name: TRANSCLIMA tropical cyclone and coastal climate risk source catalogue (262 entries)
entries.spatial_scope: Global with diverse region-specific referenced products
entries.temporal_scope: Catalog published 2026-10-28; source vintages vary by entry
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Excel workbook with 262 referenced datasets/models/tools over 14 themes including waves, wind, surge, sea level, exposure, losses and vulnerability
entries.note: Catalogue is a discovery aid, NOT 262 unique admitted or rights-cleared datasets. Recorded entries expose provider, original link, spatial/temporal resolution, protocols, access and license hints. CC BY 4.0 applies to the catalogue compilation only; individual data products have their own rights. Deduplicate with existing registry and freeze original provider/product identity before creating new candidates. Never copy source data or assume commercial licensing from catalogue entries. LIVE ACCESS CORRECTION 2026-11-03: Zenodo concept record 23736379 resolved via its API to latest record 23736380, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23736380, with access_right=restricted and files=[]. The CC BY 4.0 record metadata license is not downloadable workbook permission; mark as restricted access, no live source file.

entries.name: GTSM-ERA5-E extreme sea level percentile and return-level statistics 1950-2024
entries.spatial_scope: Global coastal model stations/grid described in release
entries.resolution_or_granularity: NetCDF ~9.7 MB; percentiles and 1/2/5/10/25/50/75/100-year water-level return values with GPD parameters
entries.note: Derived from ECMWF CDS GTSM-ERA5-E water-level time series DOI 10.24381/cds.a6d42d60, code https://github.com/VU-IVM/gtsm3-era5-nrt. Do not confuse statistical water-level return values with actual 2D flood depths or coastal defences. Review vertical datum, tide/surge treatment, ensemble/forcing and provider licensing before model use. Check overlap with GESLA gauge validation and other GTSM/Deltares products. Live API lists one open CC BY 4.0 NetCDF file ds_GTSM-ERA5-E_1950-2024_stats.nc, size 9,652,424 bytes, publisher MD5 0f2b7071c6ec3585768be6cf427e6eab. Source bytes not acquired.

entries.name: EO4MULTIHAZARDS Events Database PostgREST query service
entries.spatial_scope: Europe and additional countries represented by underlying event provider; portal shows NUTS2 overview
entries.temporal_scope: 2020-2025 initial overview; live provider records extend beyond according to catalog
entries.resolution_or_granularity: PostgREST JSON event query interface /api/events_light; event type, date, country and original provider ID
entries.note: Official docs show public example GET https://eo4multihazards.eurac.edu/api/events_light?e_type=eq.Drought&e_date=gt.2023-01-01. The complete dataset is not downloadable due to source license restrictions; source providers include EM-DAT, EFFIS, and BGS, so their records must not be duplicated as independent events. No live network probe or full API validation performed. Review rights before bulk extraction or redistribution.

entries.name: GFSM v1 global 30 m flood susceptibility tiles
entries.provider: Mirza Waleed / Hong Kong Baptist University / KAUST
entries.spatial_scope: Global land approximately 80N to 60S with regional gaps
entries.temporal_scope: Published 2026; baseline flood susceptibility, not event calendar
entries.resolution_or_granularity: GeoTIFF 30 m tiled regional ZIP archives with GeoPackage tile index; regional classes 1 to 5
entries.note: Trained using WRI Aqueduct Flood Hazard Maps as labels plus topographic and other environmental covariates, therefore derived/overlapping with existing Aqueduct candidate; NOT a new independent flood event or a flood depth/annual-probability product. Susceptibility class cut-offs 1-5 must not be read as calibrated loss probabilities. No flood defences or future climate changes represented. Check exact license/attribution, tile index, 30 m grid CRS EPSG:3395 and regional missing coverage before using; avoid large bulk downloads before access approval. Live API lists open CC BY 4.0 numerous large regional ZIPs with original-file MD5 metadata; no raster source archive acquired. The file license and upstream rights still need exact review.
